name: project-space
description: Desktop-first workspace management foundation for project-centered workflows.

scripts.build:project-cli:macos-arm64:sign: test -n "$PROJECT_MACOS_SIGN_IDENTITY" && test -n "$PROJECT_MACOS_SIGN_KEYCHAIN" && test -x dist/project-approval-signer && codesign --force --keychain "$PROJECT_MACOS_SIGN_KEYCHAIN" --sign "$PROJECT_MACOS_SIGN_IDENTITY" --identifier com.dotnaos.project.approval-signer --options runtime --timestamp=none dist/project-approval-signer
scripts.build:project-cli:macos-arm64:finalize: test -x dist/project-approval-signer && signer_sha=$(shasum -a 256 dist/project-approval-signer | awk '{print $1}') && build_sha=${GITHUB_SHA:-$(git rev-parse HEAD)} && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X main.projectMachineClientVersion=$npm_package_version -X main.projectMachineClientReleaseID=v$npm_package_version -X main.projectMachineClientBuildID=$build_sha -X github.com/DotNaos/project-space/internal/approvalsigner.expectedHelperSHA256=$signer_sha" -o dist/project ./cmd/project
scripts.build:project-cli:macos-arm64: bun run build:project-cli:macos-arm64:unsigned && bun run build:project-cli:macos-arm64:sign && bun run build:project-cli:macos-arm64:finalize
scripts.build:machine-tools:macos-arm64: bun run build:connector:macos-arm64 && bun run build:project-cli:macos-arm64 && packaging/macos/build-machine-tools.sh "$npm_package_version" dist dist/macos-release
